body:
I've previously looked at Camunda aka Zigbee as a workflow engine and one of the strengths was the ability to design a workflow graphically, and then generate the skeleton as code. On the reverse side, take an existing workflow and pull it into the designer tool, make modifications and migrate them. Is there such a thing for Temporal?

TIA

comments.body:
There is no visual tool like that that's built by the Temporal team. There may be community-led efforts or tools for this, looks like a user has been building [FalconFlow](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2kjyv3BQU0).

Closing this issue more of a discussion topic instead of an issue. This would be great question for our public [Slack](https://t.mp/slack).

title: Question: Is there a graphic workflow designer for Temporal?
